name: Monumental Squares

name: Charitable Institutions

desc: Aristocratic fighters of long service have been given generous local plots, and interest in serving loyally has increased here accordingly.

name: Village Fiefdoms

desc: A sizeable share of local taxes are delivered unto minor warrior aristocrats, the title-holders to field and settlement alike. Their mighty retinues, however, still serve.
name: Vast Martial Holdings

desc:
A university is a place of higher learning, reserved for those of good standing and wealth who are deemed worthy enough. It attracts scholars and scientists who debate, study, scribe, and ultimately pool their knowledge within its walls.

The Al-Azhar University is named in honor of Fatimah, the daughter of Muhammad, who was often called 'al-Zahra' (the Luminous).
effects: Unlocks: / Reduced Cost for hosting Grand TournamentBoard Game and RecitalContest in this Holding: … / Increased Quality of Sponsored Book Inspirations / Enables the Send to University Education Option for Rulers within the same Realm
name: Al-Azhar University

desc:
Founded by merchants and migrants from Kairouan, the sprawling complex has become one of the most prestigious centers of higher learning in the western Islamic world. It attracts scholars from far away regions and educates local elites in the finer subjects.
The madrasa is composed of several halls and rooms - offering a bed and rest to foreign students with Sahn as the central courtyard of public discussion.
effects: Unlocks: / Reduced Cost for hosting Grand TournamentBoard Game and RecitalContest in this Holding: … / Increased Quality of Sponsored Book Inspirations / Enables the Send to University Education Option for Rulers within the same Realm
name: University of al-Qarawiyyin

desc: This eagle's nest, perched atop a lofty crag, was built by the Justanids to serve as a fortress redoubt of their beleaguered realm. With its awe-inspiring setting and strong ramparts, it is near-impregnable by all accounts, and could prove an ideal stronghold for any warlike faction or sect that would thrive in such an isolated location.
name: Alamut Castle

desc: Perched atop a lofty crag, this castle has long served as a remote mountain redoubt. It has now been rebuilt into a formidable fedayeen fortress, housing libraries, laboratories and tranquil gardens among the imposing fortifications. To some, it is a place of bloodshed and war, to others a place of spiritual repose - or perhaps both.
name: Alamut Fortress

desc: Rising like the bow of a ship from a rocky crag, this fortress is an awe-inspiring sight. As majestic as it is impenetrable, it is the greatest of all castles in the kingdom of castles — Castile.
name: Alcázar of Segovia

desc: The Alhambra is a fortress built upon the remains of an ancient Roman fortification. While it is serviceable as a defensive structure, with the right investments it could be turned into something more...
effects: Unlocks:Reduced Cost for hosting Feast in this Holding:…
name: Alhambra Fortress Ruins

desc: The Alhambra has since its days as a mere Roman ruin been upgraded to a royal palace befitting an emperor! A shining example of local architecture, the color of the buildings in contrast with the surrounding woods lead poets to describe it as "a pearl set in emeralds."
effects: Unlocks:Reduced Cost for hosting Feast in this Holding:…
name: Royal Palace of Alhambra

desc: A great palace-fortress built on the Saría plain, the Aljafería is a testament to the power and wealth of Zaragoza. Imposing and splendid in equal measure; it is both an intimidating fortification and a pinnacle of Iberian architecture.
name: Aljafería

desc: While Pagan has thousands of pagodas, temples, and shrines littered throughout the city and the surrounding plains, the Ananda Temple stands as a crowning achievement among them. The perfectly dimensioned structure contains many unique plaques and stone images. It is a place of worship and a center of learning to educate the people in religious ethos.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Ananda Temple

desc: Angkor Wat is a massive temple complex dedicated to the deity Vishnu. It is designed to be a representation of Mount Meru, home of the gods in Hindu mythology. The complex is surrounded by an impressive moat and has several galleried temples, overflowing with religious art, sculptures and reliefs.
name: Angkor Wat

desc:
The Basilica of Sant'Apollinare Nuovo has only gained its current name recently, when the relics of Saint Apollinaris were transferred from the neighboring Basilica in Classe. Its history, however, is much longer.
First consecrated in the early 6th century by King Theodoric of the Ostrogoths as an Arian church, the building has seen many renovations both in structure and decoration while maintaining its unique style — an elegant mixture of western and eastern art — and its amazing Byzantine mosaics.
name: Sant'Apollinare Nuovo

desc: It is said that prince Siyavusha built this massive fortress when the world was young. Three thousand years later, it was restored by the Bukhara Khudas, the ancient rulers of this region, and it has been in use ever since. Travelers come from near and far to admire the construction, with seven great pillars mirroring the seven stars of the Big Dipper, but it is a fortification first and foremost, intimidating in its splendor.
name: Ark of Bukhara

desc: Perched atop a lofty crag, this castle has long served as a remote mountain redoubt. It has now been rebuilt into a formidable fedayeen fortress, housing libraries, laboratories and tranquil gardens among the imposing fortifications. To some, it is a place of bloodshed and war, to others a place of spiritual repose - or perhaps both.
name: Hashshashin Fortress

desc: The Aurelian Walls were built during the reign of the Roman Emperors Aurelian and Probus. To this day they provide formidable defense, completely enclosing the seven hills of Rome.
name: Aurelian Walls

desc: Known as the "Mother Temple of Bali," Besakih is the island's most significant and holiest Hindu temple complex. It is located on the slopes of Mount Agung, Bali's tallest volcano and sacred mountain. It is the island's religious and cultural heart, hosting grand ceremonies for all.
name: Besakih Temple

desc:
The Beta Giyorgis has been carved entirely out of a warm, red volcanic rock. Surrounding it are a dozen other sister temples and buildings, meant to represent both Earthly and Heavenly Jerusalem. This is living proof of the link between the Holy kingdom and this land.
Burrowed deep within the rock, the main hall of the church is lavishly painted with beautiful frescoes, while holy icons adorn the walls.
name: St George of Lalibela

desc: Borobudur is a massive Buddhist temple consisting of nine stone platforms stacked on top of each other, topped by a central dome. The temple is decorated with thousands of reliefs and hundreds of Buddha statues.
name: Borobudur

desc:
The Boudha Stupa of Kathmandu, also known as Jarung Kashor and Khāsa Chaitya, is one of the largest stupas in Buddhism, and may be the birthplace of what became the Tibetan branch of Buddhism. Its enormous dome and mandala houses the remains of multiple buddhas and innumerable sacred relics of various shapes and forms. 

Due to its placement on an ancient trade route between Nepal and Tibet, travellers and merchants frequently stop by to rest and pray.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Boudhanath

desc: The Brihadeeswarar Temple is dedicated to the Hindu deity Shiva and is one of the largest South Indian temples built in the ornate Dravidian architectural style. The name of the temple is a Sanskrit composite word that roughly translates as "Temple of the Great Lord Shiva."
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Brihadeeswarar Temple

desc: The Daibutsu of Kamakura is a venerable bronze statue of the Amitābha Buddha, weighing several tons and decorated with gilded details. It is enclosed by a great hall inspired by the temples of the southwest and surrounded by thirty-two lotus petals.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding

lines: +0.15 Prestige per Powerful Vassal on the Council /month

name: Great Buddha of Kamakura

desc: Carved out of the mountainside, the massive Buddhas of Bamian loom over any visitors. While the area surrounding them is no longer the thriving center of Buddhist learning as it once was, there's still numerous Buddhist pilgrims and scholars visiting the statues. A shrewd Dharmic ruler might even be able to pull a profit from the pilgrims, in addition to gaining some personal insights.
name: Buddhas of Bamian

desc:
The Burkhan Khaldun is the most imposing of the Khentii Mountains.
Said to be the birthplace of many Mongolian heroes, its slopes are covered in ovoos and many sacrifices are made in the hopes of gaining its favor.

lines: +25% County Fertility Growth in Mountains Terrain

name: Burkhan Khaldun

desc: Situated just west of Gaeseong city at the mouth of the Ryeseong river, the port of Byeokran is the most direct route for foreign goods and travelers to enter the Korean peninsula, avoiding the northern borders and mountain ranges.
name: Byeokran Port

desc:
The Byzantine influence on this building is strong: a small church with baptistery, in red bricks nested upon naked rocks, with an "inscribed cross" plan and a rich decoration of fresco cycles, dominating the valley of the Stilaro stream.
The church is an isolated gem in the middle of hostile nature, where man can feel closer to God.
name: Cattolica di Stilo

desc: The markets of the great city of Cháng'ān, Perpetual Peace, bustle with all manner of trade, and are an essential stop for nearly all commerce heading both in and out of China.
name: Marketplace of Cháng'ān

desc: Cháng'ān's prosperous merchants no longer blink at the sight of the greatest treasures known to man — for they have seen them all before, and probably own a few of them.
name: Sprawling Marketplace of Cháng'ān

desc: Originally based in Taga, the Chinjufu is the fortified center of the imperial pacification efforts in northern Japan, overseen by a special commander with responsibility for the region's defense and taxation.
name: Chinjufu District

desc: This geological formation is characterized by a great number of rounded, conical hills that stretch uniformly across the landscape. They are cloaked in a layer of grass that - during the dry season - turns a vivid hue of brown and orange, giving the terrain an unusual autumnal flush.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Hunt Sighting Chance and Hunt Success Chance forHunt Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Slopes of Russet

desc:
The Holy Cross has long conquered this magnificent structure, vanquishing the pagan cult to the virgin goddess Athena.
Nowadays, it holds the shrines to Maria Parthenos, Mother of God and only Virgin worthy of the name Holy.
name: Temple of the Theotokos

desc:
The holy temple of mighty Athena stands proudly once again, uncontaminated by silly superstitions.
These majestic columns and walls, raised more than 1000 years ago, have withstood the test of time and still protect the homes of the faithful from above, a silent symbol of the blessing of the Virgin Goddess who named the city.
name: Parthenon

desc:
The Cilician Gates are a pass through the Taurus Mountains that connect the Cilician plains with the Anatolian plateau.
Since time immemorial, the pass has been fortified, and controlling it meant controlling one of the main commercial and military arteries of Asia Minor and the Middle East.
name: Cilician Gates

desc: Built along the northern slopes of the Phoenix Hill, the imperial citadel serves as the seat of the court and its administration, hosting countless scholars and officials in its cavernous halls and corridors. Though not as vast as the palaces of the northern capitals, the refinement and elegance of its terraced gardens and pavilions more than matches them.
name: Imperial Citadel of Lin'an

desc: The Citadel of Aleppo is an ancient fortification, having been in use by numerous powers since it was constructed. The citadel acts as a royal residence, fortified retreat, temple and prison.
effects: Unlocks:Reduced Cost for hosting Feast in this Holding:…
name: Citadel of Aleppo

desc: After having gone through major reconstruction, the Citadel of Aleppo has been significantly fortified and turned into a proper palatial city!
effects: Unlocks:Reduced Cost for hosting Feast in this Holding:…
name: Reconstructed Citadel of Aleppo

desc: A citadel that serves as a military base for local armies and is greatly fortified to help repel invaders.
name: Đai La Citadel

desc: The Imperial Citadel acts as a fortress and royal residence. The citadel complex includes three sectors, the primary fortification, the imperial city, and the Forbidden City.
name: Imperial Citadel of Thăng Long

desc: Originally built by the Romans in days of old, these massive walls were significantly expanded under the reign of Wamba, king of the Visigoths. The early Arabic rulers widened them even further, creating a defensive system fit for the City of Kings.
name: City Walls of Toledo

desc:
A gift of land and rights, in exchange for eternal salvation. That is the covenant which has been formed between the monastic community of Cluny and the local lord.
Over time, it has grown into a lively and influential community, free of secular interference, enforcing Benedictine discipline far and wide.

Under its many red roofs, monks pray, labor and illuminate manuscripts - a model for others to emulate throughout the continent.
effects: Unlocks: / Increased Quality of Sponsored Book Inspirations / Enables the Send to University Education Option for Rulers within the same Realm
name: Cluny Abbey

desc:
What were once a few monachal homes have been replaced by a sprawling religious complex.
To cement this legacy its abbots have embarked on a colossal building project, the Maior Ecclesia. Meant to be the largest church in Christendom the five naves are longer than those of the Vatican and its massive stone vaults are an architectural achievement, teeming with towers and roofs.
effects: Unlocks: / Increased Quality of Sponsored Book Inspirations / Enables the Send to University Education Option for Rulers within the same Realm
name: Maior Ecclesia

desc: The oldest and most influential of all Confucian temples, this vast complex of halls and courtyards has been a model of reference and inspiration for temple builders all across China and beyond, with its harmonious geometrical layout and refined details. Nearby lies a quiet forest where the tombs of Confucius and his descendants have been laid to rest, forming an important place of pilgrimage for devotees.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Temple of Confucius

desc: Scholars built an academy among Mount Culai's peaks to study Confucian texts in seclusion. Its halls echoed with debates on harmonizing nature and governance.
effects: Unlocks: / Reduced Cost for hosting Grand TournamentBoard Game and RecitalContest in this Holding: … / Increased Quality of Sponsored Book Inspirations / Enables the Send to University Education Option for Rulers within the same Realm
name: Culai Academy

desc:
This mosque has a venerable story to tell. Here many centuries of spirituality and wondrous ingenuity are stratified one over the other as it is built on top of a Roman temple and an early Christian Basilica.
The building is renowned for its opulent and colorful marbles, as well as its golden mosaics pieced together by artists from as far as Constantinople.
name: Great Mosque of Damascus

desc: The Danevirke is an extensive earthwork fortification built to prevent incursions from the continent into Danish territories and has been expanded multiple times since its original construction.
name: Danevirke

desc: A revered temple in Luy Lâu, marks the spot where monks from far-off lands first came together. The brick tower, relics, and mummified masters that remain there embody centuries of devotion to Buddhism.
name: Dâu Temple

desc: The town of Dazaifu is the imperial court's administrative center on distant Kyūshū. Established to oversee the island's defense, facilitate overseas trade, and host foreign dignitaries, governorship of Dazaifu is a common career stepping stone of ambitious bureaucrats.

modifiers.cond: if administrative government

name: Dazaifu Office

desc: This site has been favored for astronomical observation for centuries, due to its geomantic qualities and symbolic geographic centrality within China. The current structure, a complex trapezoidal shape, serves as a vast sundial, with the tall central ruler casting its shadow into the trench that divides the platform, and marking the passage of the sun.
effects: Unlocks: / Reduced Cost for hosting Grand TournamentBoard Game and RecitalContest in this Holding: … / Increased Quality of Sponsored Book Inspirations / Enables the Send to University Education Option for Rulers within the same Realm
name: Gaocheng Observatory

desc:
A grandiose palace in a safe location on Mt. Taygetos, just above the fortified city of Mystras.
The palace has all the luxuries to compete with the greatness of the Constantinopolitan halls, and it's worthy of only the richest and most influential of governors.

lines: +0.15 Prestige per Powerful Vassal on the Council /month

name: Despots' Palace

desc: The Dieng Plateau is a mist-covered volcanic basin, where sulfur pools and gas vents dot the landscape. Scattered ancient temples and ritual legends make it both feared and revered, a sacred highland where ancient good and evil deities once roamed.

lines: +10% Stress loss per Level of Devotion

name: Dieng Plateau

desc: The Doge's Palace acts as the residence for the government of the Republic of Venice. An impressive structure, it houses multiple chambers dedicated to things such as the Council, Senate, administration, and justice.
effects: Unlocks:Reduced Cost for hosting Feast in this Holding:…
name: Doge's Palace

desc: The Dome of the Rock is situated in the center of the Temple Mount, in the place where the Temple of Solomon and the Jewish Second Temple stood. The temples foundation stone is said to be the place where God created the world and the first human, Adam. The Dome of the Rock and the nearby Church of the Holy Sepulchre attract Abrahamic pilgrims from all around the world.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Dome of the Rock

desc: Hundreds of years after the destruction of the Second Temple the time has finally come to restore the Temple in Jerusalem! This Third Temple will stand the test of time, vigilantly guarded from all who would see it destroyed.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: The Third Temple

desc:
Outside the city walls of Barcelona, at the feet of Montjuich hill, this great drydock arsenal arms and protects a fleet of war galleys.
Under pointed stone vaults workers labor tirelessly. Tall towers and long walls guard the secrets of their work from outsiders.
name: Drassanes

desc: Sat on the glistening banks of the Shule river, the city of Dūnhuáng marks the gateway between the Hexi Corridor and the Tarim basin, and is a key stopping point for all travelers between them.
name: Marketplace of Dūnhuáng

desc: The sun-bleached streets of Dūnhuáng know only the steady, languid march of countless laden camels, mules, and men, and their ever-crossing paths east and west.
name: Sprawling Marketplace of Dūnhuáng

desc:
Following the ancient roman walls near its northern gate, this early Christian basilica has been home to Florence's Christians since before the time of Constantine. It has suffered arson and looting, reconstruction and blessings, but it has retained its original three naves and elegant round arches.
Still, as the city grows, the old basilica may need to grow with it.
name: Santa Reparata

desc:
This is a colossal octagonal baptistery at the center of the city, dedicated to its patron Saint John.
The building is covered in expensive marbles and decorated by masterful sculptures and golden mosaics, a true testament of the city's wealth. Legend says it was once a temple to Mars, and its appearance is strikingly similar to the Pantheon in Rome.
name: St John Baptistery

desc:
A great cathedral - a Duomo - worthy of wealthy Florence now towers over the city.
The long naves and the enormous octagonal apse are dressed in marbles of striking colors, and play optical games of depth with one another. The facade is decorated with statues of prophets, gods and patrons. Its tall bell tower marks the hours of labor and prayer for the townsmen.
name: Santa Maria del Fiore

desc:
The Cupola towers enormous over the complex. Slim and air-like against the blue sky it is the greatest achievement of the Florentine builders.
The tower is higher and wider than ever conceived, with no external buttresses or support systems to keep it from collapsing, thanks to an ingenious use of a double shell of brick and masonry.
name: The Cupola

desc: The venerable market of Dvin has served as the great hub of Armenian commerce since time immemorial. Its walls are decorated with colorful tiles and tinted plasters, reflecting the wealth and prestige of this ancient marketplace.
name: Shuka of Dvin

desc: Age has not sapped Dvin's august and ancient marketplace of any vitality — if anything, the venerable shuka seems more lively than ever before.
name: Sprawling Shuka of Dvin

desc: Founded by Saichō in the late 8th century, Enryaku-ji sits on Mount Hiei overlooking Emperor Kanmu's capital, Heian-kyō, and is the center of Japanese Pundarika, or Tendai, Buddhism in Japan.
name: Enryaku Temple

desc:
This ancient cathedral is the historical center of Armenian Apostolic Christianity. Originally founded by Saint Gregory the Illuminator over a pagan temple to symbolize the triumph of the newly-adopted religion of the Kingdom of Armenia, the church was destructed almost completely during the Sasanid invasion, and rebuilt from the ground some years later.
After the 7th century, however, the cathedral has been repeatedly plundered and abandoned, and has fallen into a state of disrepair. Only a drastic and expensive intervention could return it to its previous splendor.
name: Cathedral of Vagarshapat

desc:
Our faith teaches us to dispose of the cadavers of righteous adherents by leaving them to animals and the open sky. Thusly the soul is kept pure and the community free from the corruption of decomposing flesh.

When outsiders won't allow us our rites, we must build these towers to safeguard such mortal remains and symbolize our enduring belief.
name: Tower of Silence

desc:
Rocks are extremely malleable in this area, naturally forming cones, peaks, and caves.
Humans have taken advantage of these structures for centuries, building stables, storage, and refuges, then houses and production buildings, then finally churches inside the rock cones, and whole settlements have thus formed.
name: Troglodytic Settlements

desc: Ensconced on a hilltop above the town of Khorramabad, this Sasanian mudbrick fortress remains an impressive sight. The inhabitants of the valley call it Falak-ol-Aflak, "The Heaven of Heavens", for it seems to them to rest on top of the world, and within its strong walls, they have often found refuge.
name: Falak-ol-Aflak

desc: The Fanfang is an important community of foreign merchants - primarily Muslim Arabs and Persians that have come here through the maritime trade routes - which has been granted its own district to the west of the city, with its own officials and customs. At its center stands a red-walled mosque crowned by a tall minaret and lighthouse, guiding ships and souls to the safety of the harbor.
name: Fanfang of Guangzhou

desc: The Forbidden City is a vast imperial palace, consisting of almost a thousand separate buildings. The entire compound is surrounded by a high wall and a deep moat, protecting the ruling government and the many officials working tirelessly within.
effects: Unlocks: / Governor Efficiency of Governors while this Barony is the Realm Capital: +…%
name: The Forbidden City

desc: A university is a place of higher learning, reserved for those of good standing and wealth who are deemed worthy enough. It attracts scholars and scientists who debate, study, scribe, and ultimately pool their knowledge within its walls.
effects: Unlocks: / Reduced Cost for hosting Grand TournamentBoard Game and RecitalContest in this Holding: … / Increased Quality of Sponsored Book Inspirations / Enables the Send to University Education Option for Rulers within the same Realm
name: University

desc:
Surrounded by a sacred grove is the palace of the Ghanas - royal chieftains of the city.
The complex is made up of sandstone and mudbrick buildings and is protected by a gated enclosure. Its walls are covered in magnificently colored reliefs and carvings. A massive structure, this palace dominates the surrounding town.
effects: Unlocks:Reduced Cost for hosting Feast in this Holding:…
name: Ghana Palace

desc: The Giant Wild Goose Pagoda was originally constructed in 652 AD as a place to keep and conserve texts, carvings, and various figurines. It was later rebuilt to have an impressive ten stories, until various reconstructions and restorations lowered it to seven stories.

lines: +7% Monthly Piety per Powerful Vassal on the Council

name: Giant Wild Goose Pagoda

desc: This great rectangular tomb of dressed stone is said to belong to an ancient Goguryeo king, though memory of his name has now been lost. The corridors that lead to the tomb are painted with colorful frescoes, and at the top of the pyramid rises a small wooden pavilion honoring the buried.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Tomb of a Goguryeo King

desc: Modeled and named after a gate in Constantinople, the Golden Gate of Kyiv serves as both an entrance to the city and a triumphal arch. The golden dome of the church, built on top of the gate, can be seen from afar and makes it a prominent symbol of Kyiv.
name: Golden Gate of Kyiv

desc: Gongsanseong Fortress crowns the hills above the Geum River. Built as Baekje's royal citadel, its long walls and stone gates guarded kings and subjects alike, a mountain stronghold of dynastic power and defense.
name: Gongsanseong Fortress

desc: A vast fortification system built by the ancient kings as a bulwark against the Hephthalites Huns, the Great Wall of Gorgan is shrouded in legend. Alexander the Great himself is said to have passed through its gates on his march to conquer the East.
name: Great Wall of Gorgan

desc: This mountain that raises from the jungle wilderness is sacred to the local people. Amidst the humidity and the mist, its slopes are covered in striking limestone pinnacles and deep caverns carved by the water through countless ages.
name: Gunung Api

desc: This stunning landscape of karst and limestone islets rises from the calm emerald waters of the gulf, where local fishermen drift searching for catch under the shadow of the pillars.
name: Ha Long Bay

desc: Hadrian's Wall was built during Roman times to keep the northern Picts out of the province of Britannia. Nowadays it serves no defensive purpose, but the stones make for a cheap and convenient source of building material!
name: Hadrian's Wall

desc:
The Hagia Sophia is a true marvel of engineering, with a massive dome standing out as the most impressive feature. Completed in AD 537 by emperor Justinian I, it now houses the Ecumenical Patriarch and stands as a monument to Christianity.

And so it will remain for all eternity, for surely nothing could ever topple the might of Rome.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Hagia Sophia Cathedral

desc:
The Hagia Sophia is a true marvel of engineering, with a massive dome and four impressive minarets standing out as the most impressive features. Started in AD 537 by emperor Justinian I, it has since been turned into an awe-inspiring Mosque.

And so it will remain for all eternity, for surely nothing could ever topple the might of Rum.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Hagia Sophia Mosque

desc:
The church of Saint Demetrios is the most important shrine in the city.
First raised when the faith in Christ was still young, it incorporates the Roman bathhouse in which the Saint, together with many other early believers, was imprisoned, martyrized, and buried.
name: Hagios Demetrios

desc: Since the earliest days of the Yamato, the port city of Hakata on Kyūshū's northern shore has been a naval gateway, a bustling nexus overseen by the nearby Dazaifu office, where traders sell goods from far-off lands and diplomatic delegations step onto Japan's shores.
name: Hakata Port

name: Hamadan Bazaar

desc: Hamadan's great bazaar prospers like never before, achieving new heights of wealth and activity unmatched in its long and dignified history.
name: Sprawling Hamadan Bazaar

desc: The Hanging Temple is a monastery suspended from a cliff face at Mount Heng. According to legend, its construction began centuries ago with a monk named Liaoran. Its wooden halls, built on stilts, contain shrines to Buddhist, Taoist, and Confucian sages, blending faiths and defying gravity with graceful serenity.
name: Hanging Temple

desc: Heddal Stave Church is the largest stave church in Norway and has a beautiful wooden interior. Legend says the church was built by a mountain troll in merely three days.
name: Heddal Stave Church

desc: Built by Emperor Kanmu as the centerpiece of his great city of Heian-kyō, or 'Peace Capital', the sprawling palace complex houses the imperial court, residence, and the central bureaucratic offices of Japan. Its corridors are bustling hubs of ceremony, politics, and intrigue, where ancient aristocratic families vie for influence.
name: Heian Palace

desc: The bustling markets of Herat have been renowned since the ancient Achaemenids it Haraiva. The caravans that enter and leave the city every day mark the bazaars of Herat as the Pearl of Khorasan.
name: Bazaar of Herat

desc: Herat's bazaars overflow with commerce and trade. The Pearl of Khorasan glitters finer than the most polished jewel on any crown.
name: Sprawling Bazaar of Herat

desc: Built over the tomb of James the Great, this splendid edifice is the end point of the Way of Saint James, and the crown of one of the great sites of Christendom. Pilgrims from all over Western and Northern Europe arrive in large numbers, speaking dozens of tongues — though many become mute with awe.

desc: Inside this grand edifice burns an Atash Behram, a Fire of Victory, the greatest and purest of all flames, gathered from lightning, royal candles, cremation pyres, goldsmiths' furnaces and ascetics' hearths. Pilgrims from far away lands come to behold this wonder, while the magi perform seemingly unending purification rites.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Great Fire Temple

desc: The Great Mosque of Cordoba was erected after the Islamic Conquest of the Visigothic Kingdom, upon the foundation of a Christian church. Originally the site was shared, with both Muslims and Christians using it, but the Christian half was eventually purchased and demolished to make room for the Grand Mosque.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding

lines: +0.2 Character Capital County Monthly Development Growth Add /month

name: The Great Mosque of Cordoba

desc: The Great Mosque of Djenne stands on the bank of the Bani River. Constructed entirely out of mudbrick it requires a lot of care, which the faithful are more than willing to provide. Every year, large gatherings of people converge to repair and improve the mosque.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Great Mosque of Djenne

desc: The Great Mosque of Mecca is a massive and ancient structure whose walls surround the holy Kaaba. Many great Sultans have expanded upon the mosque and its surroundings since its construction. Every Muslim is supposed to visit this site when on the Hajj.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding

desc: The Great Mosque of Samarra was completed in AD 851 by the Abbasid caliph Al-Mutawakkil, who reigned in Samarra. Its most prominent feature is the Malwiya Tower, a magnificent spiral minaret, which towers towards the skies at an impressive height.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding

desc: The Imam Ali Mosque houses the tomb of Ali, cousin of Muhammad and the first Shi'ite Imam after him. Thousands of pilgrims come to pay tribute each year, greeted by the magnificent green dome of the mosque.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding

desc: The Holy Site in this area attracts scores of humble pilgrims seeking to cleanse their souls. The grand temple is covered from foundation to spire with statues and idols to the gods, retelling ancient legends and the lives of noble prophets.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Grand Temple

desc: The Holy Site in this area is a meeting point for the devout and dedicated. An impressive roof makes up as much as half of the main temple building and can be seen from afar. Inside a great single hall can house as many pious visitors as needed.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Grand Shrine

desc: The Mahabodhi Temple marks the location where the Buddha is said to have attained enlightenment. The site is a significant destination for pilgrimage by both Buddhists and Hindus. The construction of the temple was started around the year 200 by Emperor Ashoka, and has since been improved and restored multiple times.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Mahabodhi Temple

desc: The Holy Site in this area is a popular destination for devout pilgrims. The grand mosque gives them a place to pray, rest and pay homage before continuing their journey. Its beautiful domes and great intricate spires signal the greatness of god for all to see.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Grand Mosque

desc: The Prophetic Mosque, or the Al-Masjid an-Nabawi, is an open-air style mosque established by the prophet Muhammad himself. It was one of the first mosques that he constructed, and the site was close to where he had his residence.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding

desc:
Built upon the site of Saint Peter's tomb at Vatican Hill at the order of Emperor Constantine I after his conversion to Christianity, the Basilica of Saint Peter serves as the center of Christendom in the West. 

This church traditionally serves as the seat of the Roman Catholic Pope and has grown over the centuries into a sprawling complex, protected by the Leonine Wall.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Saint Peter's Basilica

desc: This magnificent church has been modeled after the Hagia Sophia, to represent that same light, wealth and power in a frigid northern land. Austere, white limestone betrays the overwhelming colors of the frescoes within. Warmly lit by candles, shadows dance around the golden mosaics of the cathedral's many domes.
name: Holy Wisdom of God

desc: Hōshi Ryokan is an old traditional inn and a family business. It offers travellers a respite on their journey with rest, food, and access to hot spring baths.
name: Hōshi Ryokan

desc:
The monastery is dedicated to the preservation of the relics of Venerable Luke of Steiris, the hermit monk.
The holy remains are said to exude a miraculous oil, and attract countless pilgrims who sleep by the tomb in order to be healed by incubation. The inner decoration is praised throughout the Eastern Mediterranean for its quality and lavishness, as the finest artists of the age have enriched it with mosaics, icons, chandeliers, carvings, and cloths.
name: Hosios Loukas

desc: Hotin Fort is a small fort built on the banks of the river Dniester. Its location allows it to protect local trade routes and grants the owner control of the river.
name: Hotin Fort

desc: An impressive Fortress that makes the old fort pale in comparison. The fortifications have been expanded across the centuries to include high stone walls, a wide moat, and several massive towers. This defensive structure will hold most besiegers at bay with ease.
name: Hotin Fortress

desc: The House of Wisdom contains a vast collection of books, and the scribes therein work tirelessly both day and night to translate even more great works of literature. The sources vary from Greek, Persian, Indian and many more — truly, it contains the entire world's knowledge! A shining beacon of human knowledge! And comfortably far from the illiterate horsemen of the steppe...
name: House of Wisdom

desc: Completed in the 7th century, Hwangnyongsa, or the 'Imperial Dragon Temple', is a sprawling complex built by King Jin-heung of Silla as a center of Buddhist teaching and power, and boasts one of the world's tallest pagodas.
name: Hwangnyong Temple

desc: This sanctuary houses the remains of Ali ar-Rida, celebrated by some Shiites as the eighth imam, who was martyred in this land. The ever-expanding complex includes his shrine as well as prayer halls, a library and a bazaar, growing in an eclectic but glorious fashion with the ebb and flow of pilgrims and caravans.
name: Sanctuary of Imam Reza

desc: The monumental lion is the largest cast-iron sculpture in all of China, and on its strong back supports a bodhisattva gently sat upon a lotus pedestal and richly decorated in gilded details. Set near the flood-prone plain, it has become known as a warden against the rising tides to the local citizens.
name: Iron Lion of Cangzhou

desc: The mighty Iron Pillar of Delhi stands as a symbol to the glory of King Chandragupta II, though subsequent rulers have also etched their names into it. Despite having stood for a long time, there's no trace of rust – a testament to the skill of Indian ironsmiths!
name: Iron Pillar of Delhi

desc: The Iron Pillar of Dhar is constructed from the molten-down arms of an entire army. The craftsmanship is truly astounding, bringing glory upon the dynasty which holds it.
name: Iron Pillar of Dhar

desc: Ise-jingū is sacred to the sun goddess, Amaterasu, and among the most hallowed Shintō sites. The shrine houses the Yamato imperial regalia, and is overseen by a vestal Saigū priestess, chosen from among the imperial dynasty.
name: Ise Shrine

desc: Established in the 6th century and dedicated to the Shintō goddesses of the sea and storms, Itsukushima-jinja's galleries stand over the water, looking towards a famed torii gate which appears to float over the waters of Matsushima bay.
name: Itsukushima Shrine

desc: This great Shinto shrine - a taisha - has been built near the shore, facing the sea. It rises upon a series of enormous wooden pillars and thick trunks, lifting its halls high above the ground where mortals walk, and into the sky where the gods and spirits of the land live.

The golden walls of Jaisalmer houses not just a defensive installation but an entire city, in the middle of the Thar desert.
As the sun set the walls are said to turn a warm color of sweet honey, while at day they can make the city blend in with its surroundings.
name: Golden Fort

desc: The Buddhist mountain monastery complex served as a stronghold of Esoteric Buddhism. Pilgrims likened it to India's Vulture Peak.

desc:
Legends say that the Jokhang was constructed over an ancient sacred lake, the heart of a demoness the shape of Tibet. Thrice it was raised, and thrice it was swallowed by the fury of the lake, before prayers and sacrificial offerings by the first emperor's wife were able to finally pacify it.
The temple is the most sacred in the land, a labyrinthine complex of courtyards and monastic residencies traversed by cavernous corridors and halls covered in yak butter.

lines: +0.1 Piety per Powerful Vassal on the Council /month

name: Jokhang Temple

desc:
An ancient monastery erected on the exact spot where Saint Nino planted a miraculous cross while evangelizing Georgia.
The holy building attracts pilgrims from all over the Caucasus.
name: Jvari Monastery

desc: The imperial palace in Kaifeng was built when the Song dynasty established its capital in the city. A strong and efficient government rule within these walls, ensuring that the city and the realm at large will prosper.
effects: Unlocks: / Cost for the Capital Examination Activity while this Barony is the Realm Capital: -…
name: Kaifeng Imperial Palace

desc:
Constructed to provide the city with fresh water in times of need, these massive reservoirs purify rainwater by acting as settling tanks and filtering down sediments.
The system is composed of several connected sections, from a smaller basin, to a larger one, to a decorated masonry water tank.
name: Kairouan Basins

desc:
Massive walls of earth and mud, many feet high, surround the ancient city of Kano.
The earthworks cover far larger grounds than those inhabited by the townsmen, encircling wheat fields to sustain the population through long sieges.
name: Kano Earthworks

desc: An imposing fortification on the coast. Its strategic position overseeing the channel separating the island from the mainland makes it a vital control point in the Ionian area.
name: Kassiopi Castle

desc: The Khajuraho temples are dedicated to the coexistence between Hindus and Jains, where their diverse religious views are celebrated. The temple walls are covered with intricate art and sculptures, making the place truly resplendent and attractive to pilgrims and scholars alike.

lines: +5% Monthly Piety per Powerful Vassal on the Council

name: Khajuraho

desc: Gateway to the Steppe, the humble city of Khiva is notable for its abundance of traders and travelers seeking profits or fortune on the frontier.
name: Bazaar of Khiva

desc: Under the burning sun, nomads, merchants, and adventurers eke out fortunes and trade whispers of far China's wealth over the exotic coins of the Huángdì.
name: Sprawling Bazaar of Khiva

desc: Dating to the 7th century, Kōfuku-ji is one of the Seven Great Temples of Nara, among the oldest and most important centers of Buddhist thought and power in Japan.
name: Kōfuku Temple

desc:
Worked on by thousands of artisans, the Konark Sun Temple is a massive temple dedicated to the sun god, Surya. The entire complex is built to resemble the mighty chariot of the god, carrying the light from the sea towards the east.
A marvelous example of Kalinga architecture the temple is covered in reliefs and sculptures, with gods, soldiers, musicians, and legendary creatures, narrating Hindu scriptures.

lines: +5% Monthly Piety per Powerful Vassal on the Council

name: Konarak Sun Temple

desc: Krakatoa is a imposing volcano situated on a small archipelago just off the coast.
name: Krakatoa

desc:
This massive palace towers over the lush oasis of Merv. Fluted walls engulf workshops, armories and cavernous halls where emissaries and bureaucrats go about their business.
Half residence, half fortress, this great building is as capable of hosting the most magnificent of feasts as it is of repelling the most barbarous of raids.
effects: Unlocks:Reduced Cost for hosting Feast in this Holding:…
name: Great Kyz Kala

desc: The old town of Lahur was built around two major markets, surrounded by homes, all enclosed by a long mud wall. This bustling cluster of markets has hummed with activity as long as anyone can remember, and will likely hum with activity for generations to come.
name: Bazaar of Lahur

desc: Trade flows through Lahur as naturally as water flows through a riverbed. Its clustered markets overflow with goods, and its merchants seem to have all the wisdom of the city's storied history lurking behind their keen eyes.
name: Sprawling Bazaar of Lahur

desc: Carved into the side of a cliff, this Buddha statue faces the confluence of the Min and Dadu rivers, greeting weary travellers on their journey.

desc: At a prime crossroads between India and China, the merchants of Lhasa crowd for traveler's attention in the shadow of the lofty Potala palace.

desc: There is nothing new under the sun, so the merchants of Lhasa would have you believe, for there is no bauble or jewel they have not encountered, wending its way along the Silk Road.
name: Sprawling Khrom of Lhasa

desc: Lingyin Temple was founded by an Indian monk and pilgrim in 328 AD to spread Buddhism. Since then, the temple has grown immensely. It has several pavilions, a large number of grottoes and pagodas, and has enough dormitories to house thousands of monks.
name: Lingyin Temple

desc: A towering pagoda raised by kings to calm the tides and honor the Buddha. Its beacon shines over the land, a symbol of harmony between man and Heaven.
name: Liuhe Pagoda
