desc: Enlarged There have been bridges over the River Thames since time immemorial, but this one — made of mighty stone — stands grander than all prior. The churning currents below have led to the common acceptance that the bridge is for wise men to pass over, and for fools to pass under.
name: London Bridge

desc: Lund Cathedral is a magnificent church richly decorated with stone sculptures. Constructed with influences from Romanesque architecture, the church shares a lot of similarities with churches in Germany. The building is dedicated to Saint Lawrence, who is the patron saint of Lund.
name: Lund Cathedral

desc: Though this seasonal lake is sometimes merely a dry salt flat, in mid-summer the waters achieve an exquisite, pale red hue. Young poets gather at the shore to gaze upon the strange water, and ponder the beauty and mysteries of the earth.
name: Lake Maharloo

desc:
This rock in front of the coast already hosted a custom station at the times of Alcibiades the Athenian thanks to its ideal position at the entrance of the Bosphorus strait.
A fortified tower on the same small island is now able to control all naval traffic coming from and heading to the Black Sea; in addition, a large chain can be lifted to the sea level between the tower and Constantinople, effectively blocking the passage to any dangerous or unwanted ship.
name: Maiden's Tower

desc: The mountain of Maijishan has long been a place of veneration, and along its southern cliffs, considered geomantically auspicious, hundreds of shrines have been carved into the reddish rock, holding statues and colorful frescoes of serene Buddhas and bodhisattvas. Many have been commissioned by the nearby urban families, for which the site is an occasional place of pilgrimage, and meditative contemplation.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Maijishan Grottoes

desc: An academy that trains in ritual, meditation, and sacred texts, serving as a spiritual counterpoint to the Song-era Confucian academies.
effects: Unlocks: / Reduced Cost for hosting Grand TournamentBoard Game and RecitalContest in this Holding: … / Increased Quality of Sponsored Book Inspirations / Enables the Send to University Education Option for Rulers within the same Realm
name: Maoshan Academy

desc: The natural caves and hollows of Meteora have been inhabited by ascetic hermits since the early 9th century, but no human-made buildings have ever altered the landscape.
name: Meteora

desc:
As more and more hermit monks seeked refuge on the hollowed peaks of Meteora, more and more monasteries started to appear.
Man's dominion over hostile nature here is still very feeble, though; the monasteries are extremely hard to reach, mostly relying only on ladders, ropes, hand-hauling, and prayers, as the fall in case of equipment's failure is lethal.
name: Meteora

desc: This structure towers over the Hari river valley, covered in stucco and glazed tile decorations and alternating bands of calligraphy, an exquisite monument to what faith and wealth can achieve even in these remote, rugged lands.

lines: +5 Clan Ruler of Same Faith Opinion

name: Minaret of Jam

desc:
In 708, Saint Aubert, Bishop of Avranches, saw in a dream a vision of the Archangel Michael, instructing him to build an oratory upon a nearby tidal island. Aubert at first ignored this vision, attributing it to a trick by the Devil. Eventually the Archangel managed to convince him - according to legend by poking a hole in his skull with a touch, and the bishop ordered the contruction of a new sanctuary on Mont Tombe. 

Thus begins the history of Mont-Saint-Michel.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Saint Aubert's Oratory to Saint Michael

desc:
The new church of the abbey is situated atop the highest point of the island, as a testament to the power of God above all in Heaven and Earth, and to mankind's ingenuity. 

Under the abbey, a small town of pilgrims and fishermen is slowly growing.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: The Romanesque Abbey of Mont-Saint-Michel

desc:
The abbey has been expanded by a series of cloisters, a chaplainry, a wine cellar, the Knights' Room, and many lodgings, forming a Gothic complex that can only be described as a marvel of engineering. 

The abbey has formidable new fortifications, and the settlement beneath it is now a proper town, housing many pilgrims and locals alike.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: The Merveille

desc:
Recent wars have made it clear that even an island of peace like Mont-Saint-Michel can be an essential strategic point of interest. Because of this, the rock has been thoroughly fortified by heavy walls and bastions, and several new lodgings have been created for the garrison. 

The coastal town is a vibrant city now, with almost the entire island covered in houses.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Fortified Monastery of Mont-Saint-Michel

desc: Rising above Lake Venado, Mount Apo's name means "revered elder" in Lumad languages. It is a shortened form of Apo Sandawa, the spirit of the sacred mountain, also called "Elder Sandawa" or "Grandfather Sandawa." Rituals for Apo Sandawa are performed by the tribe's shaman who is seen as a medium for ancestor spirits.
name: Mount Apo

desc: Christian communities have inhabited this promontory since at least the times of Emperor Constantine I, and monks from Mount Athos already took part in the Seventh Council of Nicaea. However, no proper monastic community or permanent buildings exist yet.
name: Mount Athos

desc: The arrival of a monk called Athanasios to Mount Athos sets into motion the foundation of several monasteries throughout the peninsula: first of all, Great Lavra and Vatopedi, both dedicated to the Annunciation. With proper monasteries, the local monastic life is given order and rules.
name: Mount Athos

desc:
The popularity of Mount Athos as a monastic center, based on the many concessions offered to it by the lay power, its autonomous statutory, the truly isolated lifestyle, and its flourishing production of icons, has ensured a continuous stream of new joining monks for centuries.
As the number of monks grew, so did the number of monasteries. Twenty monasteries currently exist on Mt. Athos, making it one of the largest and more influential monastic communities in the area.
name: Mount Athos

desc: The lofty peak of Mount Baekdu is said to be the origin of all the mountains of the Korean peninsula, and its heights are a sacred place among the region's many faiths and peoples.
name: Mount Baekdu

desc: A great, snow-capped pinnacle steeped in ancient lore, Mount Damavand is said to be the prison of the monstrous tyrant Zahhāk, where he will abide until the end of the world. Many heroes of old have performed great feats on this mountain, and to those who travel there today, its mighty presence seem to touch their very souls. A dormant volcano, its slopes are dotted by hot springs where weary travelers can stop and relax, pondering the deeds of the ancients.
name: Mount Damavand

desc: The lone, towering, snow-capped peak of Fujisan marks the passage into eastern Japan and is a sight famed throughout the islands, drawing travelers and pilgrims, and granting repose to all who gaze upon it. Among the most sacred Shintō mountains, Fuji is home to Konohanasakuya-hime, goddess of volcanoes, the cherry blossom, and life's ephemeral delicacy.
name: Mount Fuji

desc: The key-hole shaped mounds at Mozu are said to house past emperors of old. For ships in the nearby bay they are a notable landmark as well as a reminder of times past.
name: Mozu Tombs

desc: Many structures compose the temple complex, all brick-built and adorned with sandstone detailings. At the center rise the great stupas of Mahligai and Tuo, the former tall and slender, the latter vast like a mountain, towering above the smaller shrines and terraces around them.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Candi of Muara Takus

desc: Located along the Batang Hari River, Muaro Jambi's extensive brick compounds protected both trade and faith. As a Srivijayan stronghold, it provided refuge for rulers and mobilized armies within the Sumatran heartland.
name: Muaro Jambi Compounds

desc: The largest and most refined of the Cham temple complexes, the sanctuary is composed of a series of enclosures scattered close to one another in the forested land, each with its own gates, shrines, and stupas. The structures are all built of red-brick, placed in geometrical patterns, and decorated with sandstone lintels.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: My Son Sanctuary

desc:
A university is a place of higher learning, reserved for those of good standing and wealth who are deemed worthy enough. It attracts scholars and scientists who debate, study, scribe, and ultimately pool their knowledge within its walls.

The Nalanda University is an important seat of Vedic scholarship and attracts students from as far away as Tibet and China.
effects: Unlocks: / Reduced Cost for hosting Grand TournamentBoard Game and RecitalContest in this Holding: … / Increased Quality of Sponsored Book Inspirations / Enables the Send to University Education Option for Rulers within the same Realm
name: Nalanda University

desc: Seat of the Sixth Patriarch Huineng of Chan Buddhism. It remains a vibrant hub for Chan teachings.
effects: Unlocks: / Reduced Cost for hosting Grand TournamentBoard Game and RecitalContest in this Holding: … / Increased Quality of Sponsored Book Inspirations / Enables the Send to University Education Option for Rulers within the same Realm
name: Nanhua Temple

desc:
Also known as 'Our Lady of Paris,' this magnificent cathedral is dedicated to the Virgin Mary. Constructed in the Gothic style, it impresses with numerous statues and enormous colorful rose windows.

On the outside, the cathedral is covered with sculptures vividly retelling biblical stories, allowing even illiterate peasants to understand the glory of God!
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Notre-Dame

desc: Offa's Dyke, which is a long ditch flanked by a wall of earth, was constructed by the Anglo-Saxon king of Mercia to defend the border towards Wales. This raised earthwork offers an advantage to whoever stands on the side of the wall, as any attackers have to fight an uphill battle from the ditch.
name: Offa's Dyke

desc: The Pagoda of Fogong Temple is a tall wooden pagoda built without nails. Rising nine stories, it houses sacred relics and statues, and its clever design remains a marvel of engineering and a symbol of faith.
name: Pagoda of Fogong Temple

desc: The Palace of Aachen was chosen by Charlemagne to be the center of power of the Carolingian Empire. It served a both political and religious purpose, and is still an excellent place for hosting important gatherings.
effects: Unlocks:Reduced Cost for hosting Feast in this Holding:…

lines: +0.1 Prestige per Powerful Vassal on the Council /month

name: Palace of Aachen

desc: This ancient edifice was the ceremonial seat of the Sasanian kings of kings, but silence has fallen over its once glorious halls, and the flowers in the gardens bloom no more. Much material was taken for the founding of Baghdad, and the people have scattered to the four winds. Yet, an eerie splendor remains, the lingering glory of old.
name: Ruins of the Palace of Ctesiphon

desc: Now rebuilt, the seat of the ancient kings is restored to its full glory. The gardens bloom anew, and the halls are yet again filled with music and splendor. Visitors come from near and far to behold the great arch of the open throne room, a long-forgotten wonder of the ancient world, that has now at last found its place in the songs.

lines: +0.2 Prestige per Powerful Vassal on the Council /month

name: Great Palace of Ctesiphon

desc:
The archaic acropolis of the city of Patras, rising on a hill of the Vodias mountains, was replaced by a fortification during the reign of Emperor Justinian.
The castle has been uninterruptedly in use since then, always under the protection of the local patron, St. Andrew, and of the genius loci Patrinella, the Roman statue of a maiden.
name: Patras Castle

desc: The city of Petra is a true wonder of the ancient world. Carved directly out of naturally occurring rose-tinted rock, the city stands as a curiosity that intrigues even the mightiest sultan.
name: Petra

desc: The Plain of Jars is a vast plateau strewn with giant stone vessels, their purpose shrouded in mystery. Once used in ancient rites, they endure as relics of a forgotten people, inspiring awe and local reverence.

lines: +10% Stress loss per Level of Devotion

name: Plain of Jars

desc: A Mongolian palace, serving both as a military and cultural center in equal measure. Its crowning glory stands as a fountain in the shape of a silver tree, where different kinds of wine flow from the serpents that entwine the statue.
effects:
Unlocks:Reduced Cost for hosting Feast in this Holding:…
The Decision to Summon Fair Courtiers becomes available

lines: +25% Owned Hostile Scheme Success Chance Add
+25% Owned Personal Scheme Success Chance Add

name: Pleasure Dome

desc: A pinnacle of Cham architecture, the Po Klong Garai temple is said to be built to honor the legendary king of the same name. It has three distinct brick towers and an impressive sculpture of the god Shiva as its primary art piece.
name: Po Klong Garai Temple

desc: This great stepped pyramid rises from the jungle like a holy mountain, each of its seven terraces holding increasingly ornate shrines and altars. The upper sanctuary crowns the structure, and protects within the sacred lingam of Shiva, the center of a complex axial plan of religious design.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Lingapura Pyramid

desc: The Qianling Mausoleum is primarily the tomb of Emperor Gaozong and Empress Wu Zetian, though several other members of the Li family is buried here as well. The burial mound is protected by a rectangular wall and the many stone statues that adorn the landscape is one of the mausoleum's most recognizable features.
name: Qianling Mausoleum

desc: Quanzhou's port attracts foreign merchants from far and wide. Traders are known to come from Arabia and Anatolia, Japan and Korea, and everything in-between. This influx of trade vessels ensures that local industries are booming and it has made Quanzhou the foremost shipbuilder in the region.
name: Quanzhou Seaport

desc: The mighty Iron Pillar of Delhi stands as a symbol to the glory of King Chandragupta II, though subsequent rulers have also etched their names into it. Despite having stood for a long time, there's no trace of rust – a testament to the skill of Indian ironsmiths!
name: Iron Pillar of Delhi

desc:
The Quwwat-ul-Islam, a grand mosque surrounding the old site that was the Iron Pillar of Delhi, crowned with a truly enormous minaret called the Qutb Minar. 

A magnificient monument to the power of the rulers of Delhi.
name: Qutb Minar

desc: The complex around Qutb Minar has been expanded with several more courtyards, gateways, and mausoleums, reaching legendary proportions.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Expanded Quwwat-ul-Islam Mosque

desc: A second minaret has been added to the complex, designed in the image of the Qutb Minar but twice the size. This colossus towering over Delhi is the pinnacle of Indo-Islamic architecture.
name: Alai Minar

desc: The Creator themselves seem to have painted these ridges in a rainbow of colors. Bands of red, white, yellow, gray, orange and yet stranger hues tint the rocky, tranquil landscape. Local rulers will often take guest hunting here, to see this sublime wonder.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Hunt Sighting Chance and Hunt Success Chance forHunt Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Rainbow Mountains

desc: The monolithic Rock of Gibraltar overlooks a narrow strait that is the gateway to the Mediterranean Sea. It was one of the Pillars of Hercules in antiquity, considered to mark the end of the known world. Looking at it now, you cannot help but wonder what lies beyond.
name: Rock of Gibraltar

desc: Built by the Romans long ago, the great Walls of Lugo remain an impressive sight. Pilgrims pass their five gates on the road to Santiago de Compostela, making the journey even more profound.
name: Roman Walls of Lugo

desc:
An unassuming monastery in the middle of the desert, but with a heavy history. The first monastic structure was, in fact, ordered to be built by Emperor Constantine's mother on the site of the apparition of the Burning Bush to Moses. Emperor Justinian financed its expansion into the current fortified monastery, also enclosing the Well of Moses. Only centuries after its foundation did the spoils of Saint Catherine arrive at the monastery, changing its name.
The monastery has always been among the most ancient and prolific scriptoria and icon-making centers.
name: Saint Catherine's Monastery

desc:
According to tradition, Lazarus of Bethany, once raised from the dead by Christ, was buried in the town of Larnaca upon his second death.
The tomb was lost for centuries but, upon its retrieval, Emperor Leo VI had the saint's remains moved to Constantinople and this imposing church built on top of the grave.
name: Church of Saint Lazarus

desc: The Great Stupa was built by the Mauryan Emperor Ashoka in the third century BC, near the site of his wedding with his wife Devi. The grandiose structure housing relics of the Buddha is one of the oldest of its kind, and it is also famed for its intricately carved torana gateways.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Great Stupa of Sanchi

desc:
A university is a place of higher learning, reserved for those of good standing and wealth who are deemed worthy enough. It attracts scholars and scientists who debate, study, scribe, and ultimately pool their knowledge within its walls.

The University of Sankoré, which started out as a Mosque, transformed into a center of learning after acquiring a wealth of books from traveling merchants.
effects: Unlocks: / Reduced Cost for hosting Grand TournamentBoard Game and RecitalContest in this Holding: … / Increased Quality of Sponsored Book Inspirations / Enables the Send to University Education Option for Rulers within the same Realm
name: The University of Sankoré

desc: The name of this tomb complex means The Living King, referring to Muhammad's cousin Quham ibn Abbas who is said to be buried here. The mausoleums are quite small and humble, yet they hold a solemn beauty that makes many linger amidst the silent tombs, to ponder the transience of life.
name: Shah-i-Zinda

desc: A vast necropolis of mausoleums, tall gates and domed passages clad in turquoise tiles, The Living King is the burial site of the prophet's cousin and many other great lords of old. The complex is ever-expanding and sublime, eerie and impressive in equal measure.

lines: +0.1 Piety per Powerful Vassal on the Council /month
+5 Clan Ruler of Same Faith Opinion

name: Shah-i-Zinda Necropolis

desc: The Shaolin Monastery is perhaps most famous for being the birthplace of Shaolin kung fu and for producing monks highly skilled in martial arts. It is, however, also a place of learning and study, and for translating Buddhist texts.
name: Shaolin Monastery

desc: This academy drew scholars studying the Classics in Hunan's quiet hills. A hub of poetry and philosophy, it carried Tang traditions into the Song.
effects: Unlocks: / Reduced Cost for hosting Grand TournamentBoard Game and RecitalContest in this Holding: … / Increased Quality of Sponsored Book Inspirations / Enables the Send to University Education Option for Rulers within the same Realm
name: Shigu Academy

desc: The Shwedagon Pagoda is a sacred Buddhist stupa built by the Mon people around the year 500. It houses many famous relics, such as the staff of Kakusandha, the water filter of Koṇāgamana, a piece of the robe of Kassapa, and eight strands of hair from the head of Gautama.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Shwedagon Pagoda

desc:
A university is a place of higher learning, reserved for those of good standing and wealth who are deemed worthy enough. It attracts scholars and scientists who debate, study, scribe, and ultimately pool their knowledge within its walls.

The University of Siena and the maestri who serve within are entirely funded by taxes from Siena itself, more specifically a tax imposed on those who rents rooms to its students.
effects: Unlocks: / Reduced Cost for hosting Grand TournamentBoard Game and RecitalContest in this Holding: … / Increased Quality of Sponsored Book Inspirations / Enables the Send to University Education Option for Rulers within the same Realm
name: The University of Siena

desc:
The cathedral of Ohrid was first destroyed when the Slavs first descended into these lands, and was not rebuilt until the area was safely back into the folds of the Christian faith.
Its last embodiment is a dome basilica richly decorated with fresco cycles from the finest artists of the age.
name: Church of Saint Sophia

desc: Both temple and mausoleum, the grand scale and exquisite symmetry of this building is sure to inspire many great works yet to come. Its great double-shelled dome is clad in turquoise, and of such a scale that it almost seems like a challenge to heaven.

lines: +5 Clan Ruler of Same Faith Opinion

name: Dome of Soltaniyeh

desc:
For centuries Somapura has served as one of the most important learning centers in India, attracting scholars from far away regions thanks to its multitude of connections with Buddhist, Jain and Hindu monasteries.
The quadrangular plan represents the true harmony and purity of the universe, a perfect place for the mind to thrive.
effects: Unlocks: / Reduced Cost for hosting Grand TournamentBoard Game and RecitalContest in this Holding: … / Increased Quality of Sponsored Book Inspirations / Enables the Send to University Education Option for Rulers within the same Realm
name: Somapura University

desc: This building is seemingly excellent for growing vegetables.
name: Glass Monument

desc: Representatives of the Three Estates meet regularly at this building to deliberate on the affairs of the realm and advice the current ruler.
name: Parliament

desc: A nine-story pagoda that stands upon a broad stone pedestal, its pale masonry glowing under the sunlit sky. It is the first of the stone pagodas of Korea, and its form and balanced proportions have made it a model for temple-builders all across the peninsula.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Stone Pagoda of Mireuksa

desc: Stonehenge is an ancient, mystical structure that has inspired many a scholar. Even today, in these enlightened times, learned men from all around Britain flock to study it. What truly is its purpose?
name: Stonehenge

desc: The monastery has fallen into ruins and has been subsequently restored and expanded by several emperors; the main contributor to the current embodiment has been Emperor Justinian through General Belisarius' intervention.
name: Sumela Monastery

desc: Many centuries have passed since the last time this monastery was renovated. The most recent intervention has granted it more hereditary lands and dependents, tax exemptions, and imperial fundings to raise new buildings. The Rock Church benefited from it the most as it received a completely new cycle of frescoes.
name: Renovated Sumela Monastery

desc: Some locals will tell you that before there was money, Kashgar already had the Sunday Bazaar. Walking between the stalls of the market, it certainly feels that way — it's impossible to imagine a time without this place.
name: Sunday Bazaar

desc: While Kashgar's great Sunday Bazaar may have lasted since time immemorial, the prosperity it feels now will surely be remembered for ages to come.
name: Sprawling Sunday Bazaar

desc: Scattered across the valleys of Central Sulawesi lie many megalithic figures and icons raised by the local people for rituals and to honor the spirits. These effigies, known as arcas, are carved with minimalist precision, their forms traced with subtle and elegant lines.
name: Sulawesi Megaliths

desc: The warm white sands of its beaches and the vibrant blue of the waters that lazily lap its shores belie the bustling commerce that serves as the lifeblood of Lamu. Long connected to trade across the ocean, goods from the western and eastern ends of the known world can be bought and sold here.
name: Lamu Trade Ports

desc: Perched atop a rocky island surrounded by steep cliffs, Mombasa enjoys a naturally defensible position that still remains uniquely accessible to maritime traffic.
name: Port of Mombasa

desc: Located on the northern edge of the Swahili heartlands, Pate Island was one of the first Swahili regions introduced to Islam and thus to Middle Eastern trade networks.
name: Pate Island Trade Ports

desc: The reefs, beaches, and mangrove forests of Pemba Island provide an abundance of inlets and resources for the people of Pemba, making it a natural entrepôt of the Zanj.
name: Pemba Trade Ports

desc: The island of Unguja's sandy shores sheltered by coral islets make it a perfect haven for ships. Traders from across the Indian Ocean come to enjoy Unguja's natural strengths as a center of maritime commerce.
name: Zanzibar Trade Ports

desc: The temple at Uppsala serves as a religious center for large parts of Scandinavia. A sacred tree stands near the temple, next to a well, similar to that of the legendary Yggdrasil.
name: Temple of Uppsala

desc: A lofty cathedral built to rival the most splendid constructions of southern Europe, Uppsala Cathedral serves as the burial site for some of the most prominent monarchs of Sweden and contains several saintly relics.
name: Uppsala Cathedral

desc: In the prosperous city of Indra, the gilded roofs and pinnacles of its temples are countless, each more lavishly decorated than the other with sculpted reliefs and statues of deities and devarajas.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Temples of Angkor

desc: Angkor Wat is a massive temple complex dedicated to the deity Vishnu. It is designed to be a representation of Mount Meru, home of the gods in Hindu mythology. The complex is surrounded by an impressive moat and has several galleried temples, overflowing with religious art, sculptures and reliefs.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Angkor Wat

desc:
The Colosseum is one of the largest amphitheaters ever built and has hosted countless spectacles such as gladiatorial combat, animal hunts and even reconstructed sea battles. Its construction was started by the Roman emperor Vespasian in AD 72 and was completed in AD 80 under his successor, Titus.

Despite its vibrant history, its primary use today is for harvesting marble and bronze for use elsewhere.
name: The Colosseum

desc: The Friday Mosque, or the Jameh Mosque of Esfahan, was built during the Umayyad dynasty. It is said that the Caliph personally made one of the pillars in the mosque. Before becoming a mosque, it is said that it used to be a house of worship for Zoroastrians.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: The Friday Mosque

desc: The pyramids, most prominently the one of Cheops, stand as wonders of the ancient world. Vast and impressive, they enhance the image of any ruler who controls them.
name: The Pyramids

desc: The Tower of London is a castle that serves as both a vital fortification and a prison. The central tower is called the 'White Tower' and houses the ruling class. The position of the Tower of London means that it's vital to the defense of the entire County.
effects: Harrying of the North Harrying of the North: Pacification increases by 2 upon construction
name: The Tower of London

desc: The Theodosian Walls were built during the reign of Emperor Theodosius II in the early 5th century, but they still remain some of the most formidable fortifications built by human hands.
name: Theodosian Walls

desc: From the sprawling temple complex of the city's ruling family stand three tall pagodas of brick walls and stone pedestals. They are the ends of an isosceles triangle, marking the sacred geometry of the site and framing the surrounding mountains and lake.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Three Pagodas of Dali

desc: Over two hundred large kilns cover the site, the largest center of celadon production in the region. The ceramics fired here are known for their coarse, hard-fired texture and distinctive yellow-green glaze, and are traded all across the markets of Southeast Asia.
name: Thuriang Kilns

desc: Scholarly institution of the Tiantai school, this academy specializes in teaching philosophy and meditation.
effects: Unlocks: / Reduced Cost for hosting Grand TournamentBoard Game and RecitalContest in this Holding: … / Increased Quality of Sponsored Book Inspirations / Enables the Send to University Education Option for Rulers within the same Realm
name: Tiantai Monasteries

desc: This ancient tomb of white limestone is said to be the resting place of Batsheba, the mother of king Solomon, exalted by many faiths. Women tend to the site, and only women are allowed to enter the tomb's dark interior. They seldom speak of what they have seen inside. The waters nearby are said to be blessed, and can cure those who have been bitten by mad dogs.
name: Tomb of Batsheba

desc: This ancient lighthouse is said to have been based on its more famous sister in Alexandria. Having guided seafarers for untold centuries, it remains important to Galicia's coastal trade. Some claim that you can glimpse Ireland's green coast from the top of this lonely tower, but gazing out, you see only endless sea.
name: Farum Brigantium

desc: Trosky Castle is built between two basalt rock formations of a long-extinct volcano. The castle derives its name from the shape of the rock, which resembles the ruins of a collapsed castle.
name: Trosky Castle

desc:
Constructed by the early Chalukya dynasty these sacred caves have been cut deep into an imperious sandstone formation. Inside lies a most holy and silent inner world.
A triumphal gate leads pilgrims into the monolithic face of the mountain. The caves are decorated with idols from all the major faiths of India.
name: Vatapi Caves

desc: The Visby City Wall protects the city from external threats such as raiders or Danes. It also efficiently keeps out tax collectors sent by the Thing of Gotland! To get to the riches within, assailants must first deal with a plethora of towers all manned by archers.
name: Visby Ringmur

desc:
This citadel is a grandiose, impenetrable system of walls and towers. It protects the Danube bend and controls its rich trade. 
Visegrad citadel is composed of a lower portion with a powerful hexagonal tower facing the river, and an upper acropolis surmounting the tall hill. The massive triangular fortification works as a residence as well as an opulent hunting lodge.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Hunt Sighting Chance and Hunt Success Chance forHunt Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Visegrad Citadel

desc: The Walls of Benin are a massive series of earthworks (Iya in the Edo language), that encircle the entirety of Benin. The walls are built of a ditch and dike structure, with an inner moat and an exterior rampart.
name: Walls of Benin

desc: The Walls of Genoa were built in the 9th century after the city was granted significant autonomy. The walls, together with the protection of the coastline, allow the area to develop and prosper.
name: Walls of Genoa

desc:
In the Thuringian forest, perched atop a great, rocky precipice, this fortress controls all movement of goods and men through the region.
A heavy barbican guards the only access to the castle, and tall white walls snake through the crevices of the mountain. The Palas, is the most important building in the complex, a massive hall of cold stone warmed by the many hearths within.
name: Wartburg

desc:
Constructed out of gneiss and limestone with the help of craftsmen from Germany, this great stone church is one of the first of its kind in the Polish lands and a testament to the power of the Church.
The massive walls offer the faithfull the promise of salvation and crucial mortal protection as well. The western tower is said to bear the marks of the Devil's talons, a testament to its defensive potential.
effects: Unlocks:Majorly increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Collegiate Church of St Mary and St Alexius

desc:
Constructed out of gneiss and limestone with the help of craftsmen from Germany, this great stone church is one of the first of its kind in the Polish lands and a testament to the power of the Church.
The massive walls offer the faithfull the promise of salvation and crucial mortal protection as well. The western tower is said to bear the marks of the Devil's talons, a testament to its defensive potential.
After being elevated to the rank of Archcollegiate, it is now maintained by a college of canons, an organized body containing solely of clerics. Its size and splendor are magnificent, but since it is not the seat of a bishop, it does not have the title of a cathedral.
effects: Unlocks:Majorly increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Archcollegiate Church of St Mary and St Alexius

desc:
Constructed out of gneiss and limestone with the help of craftsmen from Germany, this great stone church is one of the first of its kind in the Polish lands and a testament to the power of the Church.
The massive walls offer the faithfull the promise of salvation and crucial mortal protection as well. The western tower is said to bear the marks of the Devil's talons, a testament to its defensive potential.
After spending substantional resources, the Pope has finally created a new diocese here, together with the seat of a bishop. Finally, this proud building can be called a cathedral.
effects: Unlocks:Majorly increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Cathedral of St Mary and St Alexius

desc: Founded by the hermit Li Bo, where white deer roamed freely, the academy flourished as a center of Neo-Confucianism.

desc: A sprawling palatial complex of pavilions, halls, temples and courtyards, the Wilwatikta is vast enough to resemble a city of its own. Rectangular brick walls enclose the grounds, and the entrance to the processional avenue is marked by a series of towering Paduraksa gates.
name: Wilwatikta Palace

desc: The Wudang mountains are one of several mountains sacred to Taoism. They are also the home to large temple complex, famed for the practice of tai chi.
name: Wudang Mountain Temples

desc: These mountains are filled with thousands of imposing sandstone pillars rising high above the ground. While the pillars are the most striking feature, the area is also filled with ravines, streams, small lakes and caves.
name: Wulingyuan

desc: Built on the site of a fourth century Fire Temple, this illustrious building amazes traveller and pilgrim alike with its great iwans, tiled dome, and its majestic entrance portal with a pair of sky-high minarets.
effects: Unlocks:Increases Legitimacy gain and Piety gain for Funeral Activities Hosted in this Holding
name: Grand Mosque of Yazd

desc: Running several miles long, these sprawling walls have protected the city since the time of the Caesars. The walls cleverly make use of the two rivers that snake through the meadowland, shielding it from enemies east and west. All traffic is channeled through specific chokepoints, the Bars, where toll can be extracted, or arrows and fire rained down.
name: Walls of York

desc: One of the most prestigious academies of learning in China, Yuelu has long served as a center for study and examination. Its layout is centered around a main courtyard, from which corollary halls and pavilions, where generations of scholars have prepared for civil service, extend outward in balanced symmetry.
